kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننعزل (form VII)
# نَنْعَزِلُ (nanʕazilu) /nan.ʕa.zi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْعَزَلَ (inʕazala)
# نَنْعَزِلَ (nanʕazila) /nan.ʕa.zi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْعَزَلَ (inʕazala)
# نَنْعَزِلْ (nanʕazil) /nan.ʕa.zil/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْعَزَلَ (inʕazala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
